name: Augmented Summons
body:
Creatures you create are stronger than most

Prerequisite: Design Focus (creation) or Design Focus (invocation)

Benefit: Each creature you create with any creation (summoning) script or invocation (manifestation) script gains a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength and Constitution for the duration of the script that created it.
